components.name: Brownies
directions: Combine flour, sugar, salt, and cocoa in a bowl. Set aside.
Bring water, margarine, and oil to a boil in a saucepan. Remove from heat.
Stir in milk, baking soda, eggs, and vanilla. Beat until well mixed.
Add flour mixture and mix well.
Pour into a greased 12x15 pan and bake at 350°F for about 18 minutes.

components.name: Frosting
directions: Bring sugar, milk, and margarine to a boil. Remove from heat.
Add chocolate chips and beat until the mixture begins to thicken.
